findings.evidence: cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv_apply_eq_iff uses `simp only [..., FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquivRight_apply]`; _symm_fst uses `rw [... ← FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquivRight_apply ...]`. Contrast: upstream prodMulEquiv is @[expose] because prodMulEquivRight_apply unfolds it by rfl across modules.
findings.fix: Drop @[expose] from both prodMulEquivRight and prodMulEquivLeft; the complete _apply/_symm_apply simp lemmas fully characterize them.
findings.issue: prodMulEquivRight (and prodMulEquivLeft, line 60) are @[expose], but their bodies are never unfolded: cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv uses .trans, and all downstream lemmas rewrite through the prodMulEquivRight_apply simp lemma, not the body. Their _apply/_symm_apply rfl lemmas are same-module and don't need exposure. cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv in the same file is (correctly) not exposed.

findings.evidence: CircleFundamentalGroup.lean gives fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_apply_eq_iff (249), _apply (254), _symm_apply (261), _symm_monodromy (268), _eq_one_iff (276); the cylinder specializations have none.
findings.fix: Add the parallel _apply_eq_iff, _eq_one_iff, and _symm_monodromy (and an _apply relating each to the general cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv), mirroring CircleFundamentalGroup.lean lines 245-313.
findings.issue: realCylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv (and UnitAddCircle.cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv, line 175) are declared as main products but have no characteristic lemmas and are not @[expose], so a consumer cannot read off which integer a loop maps to. The circle file characterizes the analogous fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero and UnitAddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv (apply_eq_iff / symm_monodromy / eq_one_iff / apply).
cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv_symm_monodromy is not @[simp], though every corresponding _symm_monodromy in the circle file is @[simp].

summary: The two projection isos are needlessly @[expose]d (never unfolded; a complete simp API characterizes them), and the two culminating specializations realCylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv / UnitAddCircle.cylinderFundamentalGroupMulEquiv are opaque non-exposed isos with no characteristic lemmas, unlike the analogous circle specializations. Minor: a _symm_monodromy lemma lacks @[simp].
